Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday — excited to move to a focused technical walkthrough with your engineering team and security/procurement in the loop. Goal for the session: 60–75 minutes to cover architecture fit, data flow (connectors + PII concerns), and a short run of inference at scale (sample traffic).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Tue 2026-11-23, 10:00–11:15 AM PST
- Option B: Wed 2026-11-24, 2:00–3:15 PM PST

Attendees we suggest:
- from NovaHealth: your lead engineer + one security or procurement rep
- from Redwood: Priyom (SE) for the technical walkthrough, Aditya (AE) to cover commercial questions, and me to coordinate next steps

We have a short pre-demo checklist and architecture diagram attached; please flag any compliance or network constraints up-front (VPC peering, egress rules, allowed IP ranges). If procurement needs SOW/contract paperwork ahead of the session, loop them in and we’ll surface the doc and a DocuSign link.

Attachments: architecture-diagram.pdf

If neither window works, give 3 alternatives (your timezone) and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,

Alex — happy to run the session. Quick note on agenda and what I’ll need from your engineers ahead of time so we can keep to the 60–75 minute window:

Agenda (60–75m):
- 10m: Introductions + goals
- 15–20m: Architecture walkthrough (we’ll map connectors and where inference sits)
- 15–20m: Live kit — brief inference demo with a capped test dataset (10–15m)
- 10–15m: Q&A + next steps (SLA/rollout/quant profiles)

Pre-demo asks (send 48h ahead if possible):
- Sample schema for the payloads you plan to test (or a sanitized sample)
- Network constraints: egress IP allowlist or VPC peering details
- Whether inference will run against PHI/PII (we’ll keep that out of the live demo if so)

I’ve attached a short pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.md) and can own a 30m security priming call if Sarah wants that prior to the walkthrough. For the live run, we’ll use ephemeral credentials and will not persist customer data on our hosted demo environment.

Suggested confirmed slot: Wed 2026-11-24, 2:00–3:15 PM PST — please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short runbook and a temporary test token for the demo.

— Priyom
